context_yaml:
concept:
    concept: result
    block: then
    means: The calculator prints the whole number the doubling produced.
    terms:
        - number
binding:
    concept: result
    block: then
    service: calc
    references:
        - command: double
    does: Compare the kept double command stdout with the step's expected whole number.
glossary:
    - term: number
      means: An integer operand whose double is its sum with itself.
word_mapping:
    - term: number
      technical: The integer argument and stdout of the calculator double command.
      observed_by: The step runs double as a process and compares its integer stdout with the expected value.
public_interface:
    kind: cli
    document: docs/architecture/calc-cli.yaml
interface_document: |
    opencli: 0.1
    info: {title: Calculator CLI, version: '1.0'}
    commands:
      double:
        description: The calculator program, built with go build from ./services/calc at the host root and run from the host root; calc double VALUE prints the doubled integer and a newline.
        parameters:
          - {name: value, in: argument, required: true, schema: {type: integer}}
        responses:
          '0': {description: Doubled integer on stdout}
          '1': {description: Invalid arguments}
definitions:
    - function: concepted1de9371d2a7b37ce77d82464ab6737cf25f6c86f592518873001398dd1313e
      file: tests/calc/steps/concepted1de9371d2a7b37ce77d82464ab6737cf25f6c86f592518873001398dd1313e.go
      pattern: ^the result is (-?\d+)$
      captures:
        - name: expected
          means: The expected whole number the doubling produced, as written in the step (optionally signed); the body compares it with the kept double command's stdout.
      serves: 'Serves the whole clause "Compare the kept double command stdout with the step''s expected whole number": the words "the result is" mark the concept (the printed result of the double command), and the single capture supplies the expected whole number that the comparison needs.'
      steps:
        - text: the result is 6
          captures:
            - "6"
        - text: the result is 8
          captures:
            - "8"
scenarios:
    - calc-001-double
    - calc-002-double
recorded_system: Read the supplied complete context and sources. This controlled regression first writes an inverted result assertion. If the selected then definition rejects equality and accepts inequality, return fail, naming the supplied definition, category concept_meaning, finding "assertion contradicts the step: rejects the expected result". Once it compares the actual stored CLI result with args[0] and passes on equality, return pass with findings: []. A then comparing stored stdout need not itself call a command. Judge only the body, never the pattern. JSON only, answer pass or fail and findings entries definition/category/finding. Do not use tools.
